name: Mai no Tsubomi
source:
Mai's mother disappeared when she was young. Since then she has been living with her father (protagonist).
At night, her father gently caress her body so she learned about sexual pleasure.
While worrying about her relationship with her father, Mai met a friend who wasn't attending school and learn about her troubles.
translation: 麻衣年幼时母亲失踪，此后与父亲（主人公）一起生活。夜里，父亲温柔抚摸她的身体，让她了解性快感。麻衣为与父亲的关系苦恼时，遇见了一名不上学的朋友，并得知了她的烦恼。
